text:
Use with caution / monitor.

The concomitant use of opioids like tramadol with other drugs that affect the serotonergic neurotransmitter system—such as selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors (SSRIs) like sertraline—has resulted in serotonin syndrome [tramadol:drug_interactions:9]. If this combination is warranted, patients should be frequently evaluated, particularly during treatment initiation and dose adjustments [tramadol:drug_interactions:9].
